response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS overall_avg FROM budget) SELECT b.event_status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS avg_leftover, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM budget b CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.event_status, o.overall_avg
